items.text: Finalized all four round-001 decisions into plan.md: d1=A (WithTransaction helper), d2=A (tx wraps checkout_sessions UPDATE + subscriptions INSERT + subscription_schedules INSERT when applicable), d3=A (failure injection via pre-seeded conflicting row — no production seam, no sqlmock), d4=A (move shared UPDATE into each branch; subscription branch runs UPDATE inside tx).

Scope_defined held at 2 (not 3). Reason: rubric for 3 requires both acceptance_allow AND acceptance_deny to be defined; spec.json currently sets only acceptance_allow=['scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/**']. The allow pattern is tight enough that an explicit deny is not functionally required, but the rubric is strict. If the orchestrator wants to close this to a 3 before queueing, add an acceptance_deny such as ['scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/migrations/**'] (the fix deliberately avoids schema migrations) via spec update.

Initiative bookkeeping gap for the orchestrator: spec.json declares initiative='desktop-monetization-assurance', but `swarm-manager initiatives context --name desktop-monetization-assurance` lists only the research and the completed monetization-assurance-suite as members (rollup: 2/2 completed, 0 pending). This fix item is not reflected in the rollup, which means initiative status appears 'fully complete' despite an open follow-on. Consider reconciling membership (re-add this item to the initiative's items[] list or confirm that the rollup endpoint reads spec.json initiative fields rather than the items[] array).

Cross-initiative implications checked: no downstream initiatives depend on desktop-monetization-assurance. Upstream desktop-release-governance is unaffected. The two sibling initiative members (research and the monetization-assurance-suite) are both completed, so there is no sibling-item overlap risk — this fix is the tail of the atomicity work surfaced by Finding 6 of the research.

Verification guidance embedded in Phase 5 follows the 'no-restart active scenario' rule: the executing agent runs build/test/lint/format but does NOT run `vrooli scenario restart landing-page-business-suite`. The restart is listed on the validation checklist as a manual step for the user after diff review.

plan_updates: Finalized plan locks in all four d1-d4 selections as Contract Decisions rather than leaving them as alternatives. Concrete updates: (1) Section 4 Scope now enumerates the three transaction writes explicitly and adds the subscription_schedules INSERT as included scope; (2) Section 7 Phase 2 replaces the 'cleanest shape is to branch first' hedge with a committed per-branch UPDATE refactor, including inline guidance for credit-topup and supporter branches; (3) Section 7 Phase 4 commits to the pre-seeded-conflicting-row failure injection as the sole test mechanism and removes 'or stubbing the PlanOption' alternatives; (4) Section 8 Contract Decisions gains explicit entries for Transaction scope, Per-branch UPDATE, and Failure injection; (5) Section 12 Non-goals explicitly prohibits test-only seams and sqlmock per d3=A; (6) greenfield statement added near top per plan-skill-discovery conventions; (7) Section 5 schema note calls out that NOT NULL columns on subscriptions are what the failure-injection test exploits; (8) Section 10 rollout explicitly defers `vrooli scenario restart` to the user per the no-restart-active-scenario rule; (9) Section 13 DoD tightened to require 5 consecutive deterministic runs of the new tests.
